data description: Garmin GPS waypoint number associated with the individual observation; waypoint numbers are not globally unique across sampling events.
Concatenated site/subsite label for the observation location; current labels include separate LaPerouseBayBench and LaPerouseBayCliff groups.
Individual opihi identifier; values 1-144 are unique in the current table.
Observation or sampling date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.
Field classification of limpet exposure to solar radiation when observed; observed values are refuge, exposed, exposed/refuge, and missing.
Whether the individual was observed moving; values are y/n.
Raw shell length in inches, populated for individuals 1-50.
Raw shell length in tenths of a millimeter, populated for individuals 51 and later.
Raw shell width in inches, populated for individuals 1-50.
Raw shell width in tenths of a millimeter, populated for individuals 51 and later.
Raw shell height measured at the widest point, in inches, populated for individuals 1-50.
Raw shell height measured at the widest point, in tenths of a millimeter, populated for individuals 51 and later.
Whether there was an apparent path to open ocean water; values are y/n.
Surface angle at the observation point, in degrees.
Signed distance to open water, in feet; negative values point downward and positive values point upward.
Signed distance to the recorded nearest shelter, in feet; often missing in later records.
Signed distance to under-rock shelter, in feet; may contain the nonnumeric flag toofar.
Type of shelter feature recorded when shelter was present.
Distance in feet to Littoraria pintado, a high-shore gastropod used as a field reference.
Signed distance to living crustose coralline algae, in feet.
Compass bearing of the occupied surface, in degrees.
Compass bearing toward ocean direction, in degrees.
Photo reference or image sequence identifier.
Camera category used for the referenced photographs; observed values include phone and digital.
Observed color or percent-dark description for shell ribs.
Estimated percent shell erosion; some small values are left-censored strings such as <1 or <5.
Observed color description for shell inter-rib areas.
Whether the rock or substrate could be moved; values are y/n.
Substrate material or class at the observation point.
Free-text field notes, caveats, and measurement corrections.
Observed limu or crustose cover on the shell; entries mix numeric percentages, left-censored percentages, zero, and text descriptions.
Field position or microhabitat descriptor on the transect.
Hypotenuse measurement used for field slope geometry; distance along slope from limpet to water; units are in feet
horizontal distance from limpet to water; units are in feet
Angle associated with the field slope geometry, in degrees.
Coded shore type classification.
